description: S47 T7 (rule 6, MC2): a PERSON session reaching tools.mine.list. The records door forks on the caller's kind BEFORE the switch, and these two names are on the closed person-refusal list, so the answer is the pointer sentence — the door that does answer a person — and never the agent's view. A person may read any agent's whole tool situation (that is what tools.byAgent is for, and its actor is the kernel's peer uid, not a claim); what they may not do is walk the SELF doors one slug at a time and read back everybody's inventory through a door whose entire point is that only the agent itself can ask it. -32602 rather than a code of its own because this is not a missing thing: it is the right question at the wrong door, and the sentence names the right one.

error.message: invalid params: refused: this door is agent-scoped; a person uses tools.byAgent — this is the person's door, not the step's (T15)
